title: Pal Dot Dance
style: Alternative R&B and dembow with clap-heavy percussion, syncopated bounce, and half-time rap phrasing; verse rides sparse handclaps and rubbery bass, pre-chorus lifts with stacked high vocal runs and breathy ad-libs, chorus lands on a chanty hook with gang doubles and quick call-and-response. Vocal treatment is glossy and airy, with kid-like synthetic harmonies, pitchy top-line accents, and short delay throws on the anchor phrases. Ear candy includes reversed clap swells, tiny digital blips between lines, and a filtered riser into each drop. Mix is bright, forward, and club-clean with a tight low end., alternative r&b, rap, vocal, latin, breathy
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Tiang melali teka ngidih,
clap-clap, ajak ngibing ngidih.
Rappal.app, rahayu nyidang,
sira ngidih, tiang sing kepalang.

Pal rap back, cening manis,
satu dua, jantung nangis.
Lemes badan, keras suwara,
tiang ngidih, buka acara.

[Pre-Chorus]
Go, go, ajak nyidang,
pal.dance, rahayu ngidang.
Keneh mepangan, dada ngadeg,
sira teka, tiang magegedeg.

[Chorus]
Rappal.app, you got that?
Sing it back, pal rap back.
Wanna dance, pal, dance, pal
Go to pal dot dance, pal

Rappal.app, you got that?
Sing it back, pal rap back.
Pal dot dance, pal dot dance
Ajak ngibing, pal dot dance

[Verse 2]
Latin America, pal, ngidih,
badan meliuk, jantung ngidih.
Breathy voice, suba meyus,
tiang ngelantur, sira meplagus.

Slam, slam, tangan keplok,
lampah cening, sing ja jepok.
Rasa nyidang ngalahang wengi,
pal sing mati, pal tetep dadi.

[Pre-Chorus]
Go, go, ajak nyidang,
pal.dance, rahayu ngidang.
Keneh mepangan, dada ngadeg,
sira teka, tiang magegedeg.

[Chorus]
Rappal.app, you got that?
Sing it back, pal rap back.
Wanna dance, pal, dance, pal
Go to pal dot dance, pal

Rappal.app, you got that?
Sing it back, pal rap back.
Pal dot dance, pal dot dance
Ajak ngibing, pal dot dance

[Bridge]
Song pal, song pal, tiang ngidih,
a.i. ngiring, tresna ngidih.
Sing pal, sing pal, ngah,
everwhere, cening, goyah.

[Final Chorus]
Rappal.app, you got that?
Sing it back, pal rap back.
Wanna dance, pal, dance, pal
Go to pal dot dance, pal

Rappal.app, you got that?
Sing it back, pal rap back.
Pal dot dance, pal dot dance
Ajak ngibing, pal dot dance
